inputs.question: Are driveway widths or curb return radii shown on this sheet? Look for width dimensions across driveway openings and radius values at curved driveway corners along South Lamar Boulevard or other street frontages.
inputs.regionHint: along street frontages where driveways connect to streets
inputs.reasoning: The agent is asking whether width dimensions and radius values are annotated/labelled on the drawing itself (a drawing-element inspection), not whether those features physically exist or what their measured values are.
